note.ja: CTは面磁場の離散発散を保存し、採用GLMはセル中心磁場の発散誤差を輸送・減衰します。初期化・離散演算子・減衰条件を区別した上で、構成厳密解と独立Athena++参照を使うCT／GLMの同条件比較へ進めます。格子誤差と時間積分誤差を分け、GLMを厳密な発散ゼロ保証と扱いません。旧Brio–Wuは1次元流束確認、GLM Fourier例は制約診断であり、多次元MHDの一般的な検証とは別です。 採用離散化では物理2例の共通発散は可換性でゼロを保つため、別の初期発散誤差対照でCTの保持とGLMの波動輸送・減衰を調べ、減衰なしの対照でLLF拡散や位相と区別します。
note.en: CT preserves its face-field discrete divergence; the adopted cell-centered GLM transports and damps divergence errors. Distinguish initialization, discrete operators and damping conditions before comparing CT/GLM under matched conditions against a constructed exact solution and independent Athena++ references. Separate spatial and time-integration errors; GLM does not guarantee exact zero divergence. The earlier Brio–Wu case checks 1D fluxes and the GLM Fourier case is a constraint diagnostic, separately from general multidimensional MHD validation. Because commuting operators keep the common divergence zero in these two physical cases, a separate initial-divergence control checks CT preservation and GLM wave transport/damping, using an undamped companion to distinguish LLF diffusion and phase.
